description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates instances of IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, used for handling protection metadata in GStreamer pipelines within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class interface for creating IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances related to GStreamer protection metadata handling.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory instance.

methods.name: createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, given a shared pointer to an IGstWrapper.
